messages.subject: cannot increase Max Worker Processes
parts:
I have one app in free plan, and I want to increase the max worker processes. 

The current value is 1 and any change will have error in applying: 

Error updating settings.

According to documentation the default value should be 3. My instance size is 1G. The app is archived.

I found somebody had similar problem but that didn't get answer (the original question is more about memory used)
